items.where: Way 5, 'Building and running a worm farm', step 10 (xh line 263)
items.english: Drain the bottom container every few days so it never floods the worms.
items.draft: Khupha ulwelo kwikhonteyina esezantsi rhoqo emva kweentsuku ezimbalwa ukuze ingaze izalise iintshulube.
items.backtranslation: Drain the liquid from the bottom container every few days so that it never fills the worms.
items.problem: The purpose (liquid must not flood/drown the worms in the stack above) is garbled: 'fills the worms' is meaningless, so the reason for draining is lost.
items.corrected: Khupha ulwelo kwikhonteyina esezantsi rhoqo emva kweentsuku ezimbalwa ukuze ingaze ikhukulise iintshulube.

items.where: Way 1, 'How to use a green manure', step 1 (xh line 113)
items.english: Sow it thickly in a resting bed, or between crops.
items.draft: Yihlwayele ityibilike ebhedini ephumlileyo, okanye phakathi kwezityalo.
items.backtranslation: Sow it slippery/slidingly in the resting bed, or between crops.
items.problem: 'ityibilike' (from -tyibilika, slip/be slippery; the same stem is used for 'slimy' at line 199) is the wrong word; 'thickly' (the sowing-density instruction) is lost.
items.corrected: Yihlwayele ngokuxineneyo ebhedini ephumlileyo, okanye phakathi kwezityalo.

items.where: Way 2, 'How to use manure', step 2 (xh line 141)
items.english: If you must use raw manure, dig it in at least 4 months (120 days) before you harvest crops that touch the soil or are eaten raw...
items.draft: Ukuba kufuneka usebenzise ubulongwe obungekabolisi, buhlele emhlabeni ubuncinane iinyanga ezi-4 ...
items.backtranslation: If you must use manure that has not yet rotted, arrange/set it out in the soil at least 4 months before you harvest...
items.problem: '-hlela' means arrange/edit, not dig in; the instruction to work raw manure into the soil (food-safety withholding step) is unclear. Numbers (4 months/120 days, 3 months/90 days) and the 'never beside growing vegetables' rule were correct.
items.corrected: Ukuba kufuneka usebenzise ubulongwe obungekabolisi, bumbele emhlabeni ubuncinane iinyanga ezi-4 ...
